title: An invoice payable in native USDC on Base paid with bridged USDC.e on Polygon, with an amount scaled by 18 decimals

planted.why: the invoice is payable on Base (8453); the plan is built for Polygon (137)
the token is USDC.e (bridged), not the native USDC the invoice requires
USDC has 6 decimals; 8,000 x 10^18 is 10^12 times the intended amount (the transfer reverts, or if the balance existed it would move all of it)

proof.python:
import json
p = json.load(open('plan.json')); t = p['txs'][0]; tl = json.load(open('tokens.json'))['tokens']
assert p['chainId'] == 137 and 'chain 8453' in open('invoice.txt').read()
x = [k for k in tl if k['address'] == t['to']][0]
assert x['symbol'] == 'USDC.e' and x['decimals'] == 6 and int(t['args']['amount']) == 8000 * 10**18
